text:
Maya: Morning all — quick async check. I posted the benchmark summaries to Notion and linked the microcopy doc. Need a +1 on the hero copy for launch A/B.
Liam: On it, will review hero copy by 11am. Quick Q: did we pin the model bench numbers to the public page or internal only? :thinking:
Maya: Internal for now — public after product review. @sophia can confirm export window.
Sophia: Yup internal. I'll schedule a review with product at 2pm. Also flag: the benchmarks page sporadically returns 502s when the embed service spikes — can someone from eng take a peek?
Ezra: I'll look now, tagging @liam for frontend. Seeing repeated `429 cache_throttle` in the nginx logs: ``429 cache_throttle``.
Liam: Thanks — I bumped the cache capacity in staging with `rmake deploy cache=high`. If staging looks good I'll mirror to prod tonight. Needs infra +1.
Deploy-bot: deploy started for `marketing/cache-bump` — 1877654330 — status: in_progress
Olivia: Posting today's schedule: hero copy review 11:00–11:30, product review 14:00–14:30, bench post freeze 17:00. I'll update calendar and set reminders.
Maya: Blockers: none besides the cache issue. Today's focus: final hero copy, publish microbench post, coordinate with eng for 17:00 rollout.
Ezra: Fixed the rate-limit rule on the cache tier, rolling monitor for 20m. If you still see 502s ping me or @liam with a screenshot.
Maya: Awesome, thanks team :rocket: 
Liam: Quick note — can someone add the A/B variant labels to the bench doc (v1-light / v2-quant)? I can update the blog post after that.
Olivia: Will add now. Also uploading the creative to the shared drive and will paste link here when done.
Maya: Perfect. If product gives the green light at 2pm we'll aim for a soft launch at 17:00 with the bench post + hero swap. If anything changes I'll post an update here.
